contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 11
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 11 is executable. It is limited to Executive content inset, Main scroll ownership and discoverable canonical cross-workspace navigation; every accepted Rework 10 result remains a preservation requirement.
Preserve the Rework 10 SOC Dashboard geometry and do not globally restore p:3 when that would shift the SOC visual contract.
Executive owns an explicit positive content inset implemented through normal Grid, Flex or padding sizing; no negative margin, transform or offset workaround is allowed.
Main content begins fully to the right of the 164px Sidebar track; Executive headings and panels have no Sidebar overlap, clipping or inaccessible left edge.
Bind the platform root to the viewport, set the right Grid column min-width to 0 and apply min-height:0 through the required right-column and Main chain.
Main explicitly owns horizontal and vertical overflow. At 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom Executive fits horizontally with no unnecessary scrollbar, clipping or inaccessible content.
At a genuinely smaller viewport real overflow remains reachable on the intended Main scroll container; no scrollbar is artificially forced to conceal incorrect width arithmetic.
SOC-owned scrolling and the immutable Rework 10 visual and geometry contracts remain intact.
Use only the canonical Topbar to WorkspaceSwitcher to setWorkspace to navigate to WorkspaceOutlet flow; no parallel router or fake navigation is introduced.
The switcher visibly and unambiguously identifies the current SOC Analyst or Executive workspace and clearly communicates that it changes workspaces.
The UI completes SOC Analyst Dashboard to Executive Overview to SOC Analyst Dashboard through the switcher using /executive and /, without Browser Back, manual URL entry or reload.
After each switch the correct route, workspace-specific Sidebar, current-workspace label and Dashboard content render; URL-authoritative Back and Forward behavior remains correct.

The disabled Sidebar Enterprise Workspace / Unavailable affordance is removed, corrected or de-emphasized so it cannot contradict the functional global switcher and cannot become a second workspace authority.
PlatformLayout tests prove Sidebar/Main geometry, Executive inset, viewport binding, min-width:0, min-height:0 chain and Main scroll ownership without negative offset hacks.
ExecutiveLayout tests prove the explicit inset, 1536px horizontal fit, no Sidebar overlap and truthful smaller-viewport overflow behavior.
A complete structure-level regression proves SOC Dashboard to Executive Overview to SOC Dashboard through the visible switcher, including route, current label, Sidebar and rendered workspace content.
WorkspaceOutlet route/history regressions remain passing without changing frontend/src/platform/workspace/WorkspaceOutlet.tsx.

Preserve Exposed Assets 230px, no-overlap geometry, truthful neutral Trend, Gauge, Donut, status visualization, lower 632:722 split, four SOC drill-downs, UTF-8, loading/error/empty/Explainability/routing semantics, and introduce no fake data, backend change or provider call.

Run focused PlatformLayout, ExecutiveLayout, Sidebar, Topbar, WorkspaceSwitcher, WorkspaceOutlet and SOC Dashboard tests; full frontend regression in regular parallel mode and with maxWorkers=1; TypeScript; production build; git diff --check; Scope Guard; and immutable reference hash verification.

Scope Guard permits only the exact 25 allowed paths. Every existing Executive file other than ExecutiveLayout.tsx is explicitly prohibited; the new ExecutiveLayout.test.tsx is authorized solely for focused regression coverage.
The immutable reference remains .ai/references/TASK-0122-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.

Architect review must directly inspect Executive offset and inset, scroll ownership, cross-workspace navigation and Rework 10 preservation. Product Owner live acceptance at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom remains mandatory.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
